title: Shizuka Unmasks Her Deepest Fear — Part 3

series.summary: Karane confronts Shizuka on the rooftop after noticing her timid withdrawal, asking if her fierce personality is scaring the quiet girl away. Breaking down in tears, Shizuka reveals her painful insecurity about being gloomy, small, and unworthy of Rentaro, prompting an emotional and heartwarming response from Hakari and Karane that cements their sisterhood.

segments.voiceover_text: Cornering Shizuka by the rooftop fence, Karane bluntly asks if her loud, aggressive attitude is terrifying her.
Shizuka frantically types into her phone, sobbing as she admits she feels gloomy, childish, and unworthy of being with everyone.
Overcome with protective rage, Karane grabs her hands and fiercely insists that Shizuka is the most precious girl alive.
Hakari joins in to wrap Shizuka in a tight embrace, promising that they are all equals who love her unconditionally.
Wiping away her joyful tears, Shizuka blushes crimson as she prepares to voice an unexpected desire. What bold confession is she about to make?
